description: Retro computer multi-emulator platform for Cardputer Zero

store.summary: Retro computer multi-emulator (Apple II, C64, PC-88/98, MSX, MZ, FM-7, X68k)
store.description:
CZX is a lightweight C++20 multi-emulator frontend tailored for the M5Stack Cardputer Zero (320x170 SPI LCD and TCA8418 I2C keyboard, plus automatic fullscreen GLES2 HDMI output when connected).

Supported targets:
- Apple II (applewin)
- Commodore 64 (VICE x64sc / x64, PAL/NTSC selectable)
- NEC PC-8801 (QUASI88)
- NEC PC-9801 (NP2kai)
- MSX / MSX2 / MSX2+ (blueMSX with bundled open-source C-BIOS)
- SHARP PC-G850 / G815 / E200 (g800 with built-in compat BASIC)
- SHARP MZ-700 (EmuZ-700)
- Fujitsu FM-7 / FM77AV / FM77AV40 (eFM7)
- SHARP X68000 (msx68k, GLES2 VICON GPU compositor, CZ-6BM1 MIDI)

Key features:
- Startup carousel launcher with pixel-art hardware icons and Alt+4..8 quick controls
- 1:1 Pan, Axis Fit, Aspect Fit scaling plus PAR / 4:3 CRT / Full HDMI aspect selection
- Zero-dependency Linux evdev USB gamepad support (hotplug + menu/launcher navigation)
- Built-in background-threaded munt Roland MT-32 / CM-32L synthesizer (bring your own ROMs in ~/czx/roms/mt32/)
- Pitch-preserving audio sync pacing with HUD FPS% readout
- No copyrighted ROMs bundled (put optional/required dumps under ~/czx/roms/)
